_comment: VS Code MCP format reference (key: servers). Template for .claude/mcp.vscode-reference.json, which is git-ignored because it holds real tokens. Copy it, replace each <...> placeholder, and keep it in step with .mcp.json (key: mcpServers), the active Claude Code config.
_cli-syntax: mcp-compressor 0.31.4 requires `--compression` (not --compression-level), `-H` (not --header), and a `--` separator before the backend URL/args. Backends with no real Authorization header also need a placeholder `-H Authorization=Bearer unused`, or mcp-compressor auto-attempts OAuth discovery and fails.

context7.// note: Upstash SaaS — no self-hosting option. Compresses 17k → ~300 tokens.
